name: Koihime
source:
Musashi returns to the remote country village where his grandmother lives after being away for 15 years. However, once he gets there, he finds that he has somehow forgotten four different girls whom he had promised to marry when he was a child.

[Taken from [url=http://www.animenewsnetwork.com/encyclopedia/anime.php?id=275]ANN[/url]]
translation:
武藏离开15年后，回到了祖母居住的偏远乡村。然而抵达那里后，他发现自己不知为何已经忘记了四名不同的少女——童年时，他曾分别答应要娶她们为妻。

[摘自[url=http://www.animenewsnetwork.com/encyclopedia/anime.php?id=275]ANN[/url]]
